ModMetaData.name: Mounted Arms
ModMetaData.author: Felipe
ModMetaData.description:
Adds modern mounted-weapon turrets, balanced for vanilla and with a full Combat Extended layer.
Automatic turrets (power): - M240 machine gun, M134 minigun, Mk44 Bushmaster chain gun - 80 mm rocket pod, 20 mm CIWS - Guided rocket battery (indirect arcing fire, mortar-like)
Manned turrets (colonist operates): - M2 Browning .50, Mk19 grenade launcher, TOW anti-tank missile - Bofors 40 mm L/60 naval anti-aircraft gun, twin and quad mounts
Portable: - M252 81 mm mortar (minifiable)
Features: barrel overheating, turret slew speed, shot dispersion, muzzle at the barrel. Requires Harmony. Combat Extended is optional; with it, the Bofors and the CIWS also shoot down incoming shells and missiles (and the Bofors, drop pods).
